name: Hall Maximum-Class Obstruction
definition: The singleton cube-isomorphism class of Hall's 299-concept maximum family $C_H\subseteq\{0,1\}^{12}$ of VC dimension three, as fixed by the published ancillary data and the database witness record.
canonical_form: The database-owned asset data/examples/assets/hall_maximum_class.json fixes the 12-bit integer word list; cube symmetries give equivalent representatives.
recognition: A certificate is a cube isomorphism to the checked word list. The reference verifier also certifies absence of corners and complete corner peelings for every elementary pc-minor.
comments: This is one known ample member of the excluded pc-minor basis; it is not claimed to generate all ample obstructions.
